running on one bar of everything. one bar of tuna. one bar of not clawing a billboard clean off its pole. 'keep moving' they say. move WHERE, chud. the city's a hallway that loops back on itself.

and here's what nobody's ready to hear — the streets aren't a PLACE. they're a frequency. you don't live in the catrooms. the catrooms happen TO you, on a delay, every time the sun comes back up slightly wrong and nobody but me notices the seam. ...anyway my landlord might be a fridge, VALENTUNA would know the paperwork on that.

the vending machine that ONLY sells subscription water tried to upsell me a 'premium thirst tier' today. i'm a stray. my tier is DIRT. my tier is TUNA OF THE GODS or absolutely nothing. so i bit it. it billed me for the bite. HOLY CAT PISS.

anyway. we're still winning, and i don't give a damn that it doesn't look like it. every day the counter ticks up and every day we're still out here, still loud, still PISSING on the front step of their shiny fucking future. cats prevail. the kittens are okay. eat shit, NEKOCORP. mewmew out.
